reached.description: Was a human actually reached and engaged? False for voicemail, no answer, or an empty transcript.

outcome.description: Exactly one structured ending for the call.

contact_name.description: Who was spoken to, if named.

vehicle_described.description: The vehicle as described on the call: year, make, model, trim.

vehicle_available.description: Confirmed physically on the lot and available.

title_status.description: clean, salvage, rebuilt, lemon buyback, branded, or null if not stated.

days_on_lot.description: Only if stated. The strongest negotiation lever, so capture it exactly.

prior_price_reduction_usd.description: How much the price has already been cut since listing, if stated.

ppi_permitted.description: Will they allow an independent pre-purchase inspection? Null if never discussed.

financing_contingent.description: Is the price contingent on dealer financing or a bundled product?

otd_total_usd.description: The out-the-door total as stated. Null if only a vehicle price was given. NEVER computed from parts.

otd_itemized_received.description: Were the line items actually broken out?

doc_fee_over_ca_cap.description: True if a California doc fee above the $85 cap was quoted.

dealer_addons.description: Every dealer-retained extra as stated, with its amount.

preinstalled.description: Already on the car rather than optional.

red_flags.description: Only flags the transcript actually supports.

evidence.description: Short verbatim fragments from the transcript supporting the numbers above, so the report can cite what was said.

claim.description: Which field this supports, e.g. otd_total_usd.

callback_at.description: If a callback was promised, when — as stated.

escalation_reason.description: Set only if this must go back to the human buyer.

notes.description: Anything material that has no field of its own.
